ctx: SUBTITLE D. JUDICIAL RETIREMENT SYSTEM OF TEXAS PLAN ONE

l: p
The board of trustees of the Employees Retirement System of Texas is responsible for the general administration and operation of the retirement system.
p
Subject to the limitations of this subtitle, the board of trustees may adopt rules and provide for forms as it finds necessary for the administration of the retirement system.
p

(a) The retirement system shall deposit membership fees paid as required by Section 832.002 in the expense fund of the Employees Retirement System of Texas, to compensate for the costs of administering this retirement system.
p
(b) The retirement system shall deposit in the general revenue fund all other amounts paid to the system.
p

(a) Except as provided by Subsection (c), each month the payroll officer responsible for paying the state compensation of a judicial officer who is a member of the retirement system shall deduct from the state compensation of the judicial officer a contribution computed at the rate required of a member of the employee class of the Employees Retirement System of Texas.
p
(b) Contributions deducted as provided by this section are deposited in the general revenue fund, where they are subject to appropriation as are other amounts in the fund.
p
(c) Except as provided by Section 835.1015, a member who accrues 20 years of service credit in the retirement system ceases making contributions under this section.

items.t: CONTRIBUTIONS AFTER 20 YEARS OF SERVICE CREDIT
l: p

(a) A judicial officer who is a member of the retirement system and who accrues 20 years of service credit in the retirement system may elect to make contributions for each subsequent year of service credit that the member accrues by filing an application with the retirement system.
p

(b) A member who elects to make contributions under Subsection (a) shall contribute at the member contribution rate required under Section 840.102(a) multiplied by the member's state compensation for each payroll period in the manner provided by Sections 835.101(a) and (b).
p
(c) Repealed by Acts 2009, 81st Leg., R.S., Ch. 1308, Sec. 41(3), eff. September 1, 2009.
p
The legislature is obligated to appropriate the amount of money necessary to administer this subtitle for each fiscal year.
